From Wiktionary, the free dictionary English [ edit ] English Wikipedia has an article on: menial Wikipedia Etymology [ edit ] From Middle English meyneal , from Anglo-Norman mesnal , from maisnee ( “ household ” ) , from Vulgar Latin *mānsiōnāta , from Latin mānsiō ( “ house ” ) . Pronunciation [ edit ] enPR : mē'nēəl , IPA ( key ) : /ˈmiːni.əl/ Audio ( Southern England ) : Duration: 2 seconds. 0:02 ( file ) Adjective [ edit ] menial ( comparative more menial , superlative most menial ) Of or relating to work normally performed by a servant . quotations ▼ 1837 , L[etitia] E[lizabeth] L[andon] , “Arrived at Home”, in Ethel Churchill: Or, The Two Brides. [ … ] , volume I, London: Henry Colburn , [ … ] , →OCLC , page 85 : She hung round him, watching his every look as if she grudged the veriest menial offices from the servants; and she almost scolded him for not eating, when he had done justice enough to the good things set before him to have satisfied even the cook herself. 1915 , W[illiam] Somerset Maugham , chapter LXX, in Of Human Bondage , New York, N.Y.: George H[enry] Doran Company , →OCLC : She was not proposing to go out again, so he got her slippers and took off her boots. It delighted him to perform menial offices. Of or relating to unskilled work. quotations ▼ menial job 1910 October 1, G[ilbert] K[eith] Chesterton , “The Queer Feet”, in The Innocence of Father Brown , London, New York, N.Y.: Cassell and Company , published 1911 , →OCLC : Father Brown took the paper without a word, and obediently went to look for the coat; it was not the first menial work he had done in his life. 1913 August, Jack London , John Barleycorn , New York, N.Y.: The Century Co. , →OCLC : I didn't see how sweeping and scrubbing a building was any preparation for the trade of electrician; but I did know that in the books all the boys started with the most menial tasks and by making good ultimately won to the ownership of the whole concern. 2011 , Chris Manning, Sudarno Sumarto, Employment, Living Standards and Poverty in Contemporary Indonesia , →ISBN : For instance, controlling for the above-mentioned variables, migrants to Tangerang or Samarinda (rather than Medan) have a significantly greater chance of getting a craft (as opposed to menial ) job. Table of Contents 1 Ypsilanti's Environmental Injustices Today 2 Historical redlining in the US 3 A Very Brief History of Ypsilanti 4 Uncovering Ypsilanti's Historical Redlining 5 some ideas.... A Very Brief History of Ypsilanti Native Americans Long before Ypsilanti was known as Ypsilanti, the area was inhabited primarily by the Potawatomi and Wyandot Indians, among other Native American tribes. ○ Open citation. They built trails throughout the city, one of which is now Michigan Avenue (highlighted in yellow), and settlements just south of present-day Michigan Avenue Jump to Edgenote (triangle also highlighted in yellow). Photo credit : Mark Maynard 1931 Hinsdale map of current-day Ypsilanti area showing Native American settlements prior to 1800s Return to narrative By the 1830s, Native Americans were forcibly removed from newly incorporated City of Ypsilanti Jump to Edgenote and the larger Southeast Michigan area as White Europeans developed trading posts and villages in the area. Throughout this time and the decades that followed, Ypsilanti became critical settlement for Black slaves escaping the south along the Underground Railroad Jump to Edgenote . Where these Black communities were allowed to settle isn’t surprising. Learn more about how Ypsilanti got it's unique name cityofypsilanti.com › Return to narrative Learn more about the Underground Railroad in Ypsilanti youtube.com › Return to narrative Black Americans The vast majority of Black residents were segregated to the southside of Ypslanti Jump to Edgenote – south of Michigan Avenue – where the former Native American settlements were located. Throughout the late 1800s and early 1900s, life for Black residents of Ypsilanti told a similar story to other Black Americans at the time – a story of segregation. Segregated homes. Segregated schools. Segregated restaurants. A former Black Ypsilanti teacher, Marguerite Eaglin, tells a story Jump to Edgenote of how segregation looked like during the 1950s in the city. African American Ypsilanti, 1910. - Google My Maps google.com › Return to narrative “ They finally served us, but they burned the bread ” — Marguerite Eaglin, ca. 1980s Return to narrative “ … and the fact that because I was black, there were restaurants downtown that didn’t want us to come and eat. My children told me the story about how good Haab’s french fries were, but they had to stand outside and buy them from the window if they wanted any. I wasn’t aware of that. My friend Yvonne Williams and I would go downtown for lunch and we’d go into a place and sit and sit and sit. I was teaching school, so I only had so much time for lunch. Nobody actively insulted us, but they just didn’t wait on us. They just ignored us like we weren’t there. Finally in one place, I said, “Look, I have to go back to school. Do you know when we could get served, please?” They finally served us, but they burned the bread.” – Marguerite Eaglin, ca. 1980s Jump to Edgenote  …[truncated]

state.visible_text: MetaMask® Extension - Browser extension - webflow MetaMask® Extension - Browser extension - webflow In the rapidly evolving landscape of blockchain technology, MetaMask stands out as a cornerstone tool, empowering users to navigate the decentralized web with ease and security. At its core, MetaMask is an extension for web browsers that serves as a bridge between traditional web interfaces and blockchain-based applications. With its intuitive interface and robust features, MetaMask has become indispensable for cryptocurrency enthusiasts, developers, and everyday users alike. The installation process for MetaMask is straightforward, typically requiring just a few clicks to add the extension to your preferred web browser, such as Google Chrome, Firefox, or Brave. Once installed, MetaMask prompts users to create a new wallet or import an existing one using a seed phrase or private key. This initial setup is crucial, as it establishes the foundation for securely managing digital assets and interacting with decentralized applications. One of the key features of MetaMask is its cryptocurrency wallet functionality. Users can store, send, and receive a variety of digital assets, including popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum, as well as tokens issued on these blockchains. MetaMask employs industry-standard encryption techniques to protect user data, ensuring that sensitive information remains secure at all times. Additionally, MetaMask supports the integration of hardware wallets for enhanced security, providing users with peace of mind knowing that their funds are safeguarded against unauthorized access. Beyond its role as a cryptocurrency wallet, MetaMask serves as a gateway to the world of decentralized finance (DeFi). Through MetaMask, users can access a wide range of DeFi protocols and platforms, including decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending and borrowing platforms, and yield farming protocols. This seamless integration enables users to participate in decentralized finance activities directly from their browser, without the need for intermediary services or centralized exchanges. Whether you're looking to swap tokens, earn interest on your assets, or provide liquidity to decentralized liquidity pools, MetaMask provides the tools you need to engage with the burgeoning DeFi ecosystem. MetaMask's compatibility with various blockchain networks further enhances its utility and versatility. While initially designed for the Ethereum blockchain, MetaMask has expanded its support to include other networks such as Binance Smart Chain and Polygon (formerly Matic Network). This multi-chain compatibility enables users to access a diverse array of decentralized applications and services, catering to different use cases and preferences within the blockchain space. Whether you're exploring decentralized gaming, decentralized identity solutions, or decentralized social networks, MetaMask offers seamless connectivity to a wide range of blockchain networks and protocols. The user interface of MetaMask is designed with simplicity and accessibility in mind, making it easy for both newcomers and experienced users to navigate the decentralized web. The extension provides a familiar browsing experience, with features such as account management, transaction history, and customizable settings readily accessible within a few clicks. Additionally, MetaMask offers support for mobile devices through its mobile app, allowing users to manage their digital assets and interact with DApps on the go. In conclusion, MetaMask extension plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of the decentralized web, empowering users to take control of their digital assets and participate in the burgeoning ecosystem of blockchain-based applications and services. With its seamless browser integration, robust security features, and compatibility with multiple blockchain networks, MetaMask has become an essential tool for anyone interested in exploring the possibilities of decentralized innovation. Whether you're a cryptocurrency enthusiast, a developer building decentralized applications, or simply curious about the potential of blockchain technology, MetaMask provides a user-friendly gateway to the decentralized web.

Discover Health Earning Knowledge Hub Customer Support About us Return to articles What Are the Requirements for a Mexican Passport? legal By William Leborgne | Published 10/28/2022 Getting a Mexican Passport inside or outside the US is an easy and quick process. If you’re Mexican and have never applied for it—or maybe it expired or was lost —read our guide to learn what you need to get a new one. It’s one of the most important documents and you don’t want to wait until you really need it! Your opinion matters! Discover paid surveys Start earning! Procedure to Apply for a Mexican Passport The process of getting your passport is relatively simple if you know the requirements and gather the necessary documents in advance. These are the steps to follow to complete the process: Schedule an appointment. Use the SREs appointment portal . You must indicate whether you wish to make your application at a Consular Office abroad or a liaison office of the SRE. You’ll then choose the date and time of your appointment depending on the availability of the selected office. Bring the necessary documents to your appointment. The records required to obtain your passport will depend on your specific case. In the following section, we'll show you which documents you might need and in which circumstances. Receive your new passport. Passports are delivered the same day if you process your passport in the US or a consulate within the US. If you initiate the process from a consulate in another country, it may take up to 30 days for your document to arrive (except for emergency passports). First-Time Passport Issuance Applying for a Mexican passport for the first time is very similar to applying for a renewal or replacement passport. The main difference when you apply for it for the first time is that you must prove your Mexican nationality with documentation, such as a birth certi ficate or naturalization letter. Passport Renewal It's much simpler when it comes to renewals, as your expired passport serves as proof of your nationality. Unlike a first-time issuance, you don’t need to present another document proving your nationality. From Wiktionary, the free dictionary English [ edit ] English Wikipedia has an article on: menial Wikipedia Etymology [ edit ] From Middle English meyneal , from Anglo-Norman mesnal , from maisnee ( “ household ” ) , from Vulgar Latin *mānsiōnāta , from Latin mānsiō ( “ house ” ) . [ … ] , volume I, London: Henry Colburn , [ … ] , →OCLC , page 85 : She hung round him, watching his every look as if she grudged the veriest menial offices from the servants; and she almost scolded him for not eating, when he had done justice enough to the good things set before him to have satisfied even the cook herself. 1915 , W[illiam] Somerset Maugham , chapter LXX, in Of Human Bondage , New York, N.Y.: George H[enry] Doran Company , →OCLC : She was not proposing to go out again, so he got her slippers and took off her boots. A Very Brief History of Ypsilanti Native Americans Long before Ypsilanti was known as Ypsilanti, the area was inhabited primarily by the Potawatomi and Wyandot Indians, among other Native American tribes. ○ Open citation. They built trails throughout the city, one of which is now Michigan Avenue (highlighted in yellow), and settlements just south of present-day Michigan Avenue Jump to Edgenote (triangle also highlighted in yellow). Photo credit : Mark Maynard 1931 Hinsdale map of current-day Ypsilanti area showing Native American settlements prior to 1800s Return to narrative By the 1830s, Native Americans were forcibly removed from newly incorporated City of Ypsilanti Jump to Edgenote and the larger Southeast Michigan area as White Europeans developed trading posts and villages in the area. Throughout this time and the decades that followed, Ypsilanti became critical settlement for Black slaves escaping the south along the Underground Railroad Jump to Edgenote . Where these Black communities were allowed to settle isn’t surprising. Learn more about how Ypsilanti got it's unique name cityofypsilanti.com › Return to narrative Learn more about the Underground Railroad in Ypsilanti youtube.com › Return to narrative Black Americans The vast majority of Black residents were segregated to the southside of Ypslanti Jump to Edgenote – south of Michigan Avenue – where the former Native American settlements were located. Throughout the late 1800s and early 1900s, life for Black residents of Ypsilanti told a similar story to other Black Americans at the time – a story of segregation. Segregated homes. Segregated schools. Segregated restaurants. A former Black Ypsilanti teacher, Marguerite Eaglin, tells a story Jump to Edgenote of how segregation looked like during the 1950s in the city. African American Ypsilanti, 1910. - Google My Maps google.com › Return to narrative “ They finally served us, but they burned the bread ” — Marguerite Eaglin, ca. 1980s Return to narrative “ … and the fact that because I was black, there were restaurants downtown that didn’t want us to come and eat. My children told me the story about how good Haab’s french fries were, but they had to stand outside and buy them from the window if they wanted any. I wasn’t aware of that. My friend Yvonne Williams and I would go downtown for lunch and we’d go into a place and sit and sit and sit. I was teaching school, so I only had so much time for lunch. Nobody actively insulted us, but they just didn’t wait on us. They just ignored us like we weren’t there. Finally in one place, I said, “Look, I have to go back to school. Do you know when we could get served, please?” They finally served us, but they burned the bread.” – Marguerite Eaglin, ca. 1980s Jump to Edgenote  …[truncated]

Compared with more traditional sequential planning for permanency, in which one permanency plan is ruled out before an alternative is developed, concurrent planning may provide earlier permanency for a child. This publication presents a general overview of this aspect of child welfare law. Summaries of laws on this topic for all individual States and U.S. territories are available from the State Statutes Search page. This publication is a product of the State Statutes Series prepared by Child Welfare Information Gateway. state.visible_text: MetaMask® Extension - Browser extension - webflow MetaMask® Extension - Browser extension - webflow In the rapidly evolving landscape of blockchain technology, MetaMask stands out as a cornerstone tool, empowering users to navigate the decentralized web with ease and security. At its core, MetaMask is an extension for web browsers that serves as a bridge between traditional web interfaces and blockchain-based applications. With its intuitive interface and robust features, MetaMask has become indispensable for cryptocurrency enthusiasts, developers, and everyday users alike. The installation process for MetaMask is straightforward, typically requiring just a few clicks to add the extension to your preferred web browser, such as Google Chrome, Firefox, or Brave. Once installed, MetaMask prompts users to create a new wallet or import an existing one using a seed phrase or private key. This initial setup is crucial, as it establishes the foundation for securely managing digital assets and interacting with decentralized applications. One of the key features of MetaMask is its cryptocurrency wallet functionality. Users can store, send, and receive a variety of digital assets, including popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum, as well as tokens issued on these blockchains. MetaMask employs industry-standard encryption techniques to protect user data, ensuring that sensitive information remains secure at all times. Additionally, MetaMask supports the integration of hardware wallets for enhanced security, providing users with peace of mind knowing that their funds are safeguarded against unauthorized access. Beyond its role as a cryptocurrency wallet, MetaMask serves as a gateway to the world of decentralized finance (DeFi). Through MetaMask, users can access a wide range of DeFi protocols and platforms, including decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending and borrowing platforms, and yield farming protocols. This seamless integration enables users to participate in decentralized finance activities directly from their browser, without the need for intermediary services or centralized exchanges. Whether you're looking to swap tokens, earn interest on your assets, or provide liquidity to decentralized liquidity pools, MetaMask provides the tools you need to engage with the burgeoning DeFi ecosystem. MetaMask's compatibility with various blockchain networks further enhances its utility and versatility. While initially designed for the Ethereum blockchain, MetaMask has expanded its support to include other networks such as Binance Smart Chain and Polygon (formerly Matic Network). This multi-chain compatibility enables users to access a diverse array of decentralized applications and services, catering to different use cases and preferences within the blockchain space. Whether you're exploring decentralized gaming, decentralized identity solutions, or decentralized social networks, MetaMask offers seamless connectivity to a wide range of blockchain networks and protocols. The user interface of MetaMask is designed with simplicity and accessibility in mind, making it easy for both newcomers and experienced users to navigate the decentralized web. The extension provides a familiar browsing experience, with features such as account management, transaction history, and customizable settings readily accessible within a few clicks. Additionally, MetaMask offers support for mobile devices through its mobile app, allowing users to manage their digital assets and interact with DApps on the go. In conclusion, MetaMask extension plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of the decentralized web, empowering users to take control of their digital assets and participate in the burgeoning ecosystem of blockchain-based applications and services. With its seamless browser integration, robust security features, and compatibility with multiple blockchain networks, MetaMask has become an essential tool for anyone interested in exploring the possibilities of decentralized innovation. Whether you're a cryptocurrency enthusiast, a developer building decentralized applications, or simply curious about the potential of blockchain technology, MetaMask provides a user-friendly gateway to the decentralized web.

Discover Health Earning Knowledge Hub Customer Support About us Return to articles What Are the Requirements for a Mexican Passport? legal By William Leborgne | Published 10/28/2022 Getting a Mexican Passport inside or outside the US is an easy and quick process. If you’re Mexican and have never applied for it—or maybe it expired or was lost —read our guide to learn what you need to get a new one. It’s one of the most important documents and you don’t want to wait until you really need it! Your opinion matters! Discover paid surveys Start earning! Procedure to Apply for a Mexican Passport The process of getting your passport is relatively simple if you know the requirements and gather the necessary documents in advance. These are the steps to follow to complete the process: Schedule an appointment. Use the SREs appointment portal . You must indicate whether you wish to make your application at a Consular Office abroad or a liaison office of the SRE. You’ll then choose the date and time of your appointment depending on the availability of the selected office. Bring the necessary documents to your appointment. The records required to obtain your passport will depend on your specific case. In the following section, we'll show you which documents you might need and in which circumstances. Receive your new passport. Passports are delivered the same day if you process your passport in the US or a consulate within the US. If you initiate the process from a consulate in another country, it may take up to 30 days for your document to arrive (except for emergency passports). First-Time Passport Issuance Applying for a Mexican passport for the first time is very similar to applying for a renewal or replacement passport. The main difference when you apply for it for the first time is that you must prove your Mexican nationality with documentation, such as a birth certi ficate or naturalization letter. Passport Renewal It's much simpler when it comes to renewals, as your expired passport serves as proof of your nationality. Unlike a first-time issuance, you don’t need to present another document proving your nationality. Minors In addition to complying with all the standard requirements, all minors must present themselves with their legal guardian(s).
